claims: Continue mechanical ventilation in CPAP/PSV mode with PEEP 5 cmH2O and FiO2 30%, monitoring tidal volumes, respiratory rate, and peak pressures.
Continue norepinephrine infusion at approximately 0.05 mcg/kg/min, titrating to maintain MAP ≥65 mmHg given recent MAP of 66–68 mmHg.
Monitor arterial blood pressure invasively via arterial line, with alarms set appropriately, and reassess hemodynamic targets.
Continue propofol infusion for sedation, titrating to target RASS of -1 to 0, and reassess sedation depth regularly.
Continue scheduled antibiotics (cefepime, vancomycin, ampicillin) and acyclovir as ordered, and monitor for clinical response and potential adverse effects.
Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and glucose (fingerstick glucose 120–145 mg/dL) and replace electrolytes as needed (e.g., potassium, magnesium).
Perform regular neurologic assessments including RASS and CAM-ICU, and monitor mental status given fluctuating RASS (+1 to -1) and GCS eye opening none.
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest with assistance for mobility, given high fall risk score and bedfast status.
Provide oral care with chlorhexidine gluconate 0.12% rinse and subglottic suctioning to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
Monitor temperature and consider infectious workup if fever develops (current temp 99.3–99.8°F).
